## Gap analysis (existing seams vs ticket scope)

S6.2 landed the campaign state machine, the `evolution_proposer` class +
conformance suite, and the `ahe` first-party variant (one class,
`instrument-grade`). `hh-hir` already carried `CompiledPayload` +
`ProcedureStep::Opaque` + `OpaqueWithoutInterface`, `ReplaceLeaf` over
payload leaves, and `validate`; `hh-registry` already carried
`lifecycle::install_plan` with the `TrustView.model_install` gate;
`hh-ledger` already carried the audit-grade `transitioned` class.
What did not exist: the research families (`rho`, `gene_bank`,
`code_search`), the multi-`target_classes` surface, `voi`/`concentrate`
slot allocations, the `niche`/`trajectory_refs` selectors, `rebase`,
hosted-coordinate admission over `hh-hosting/1`, the `authority_cap`
install ceiling, and the `research-grade`/`preview` wall.

| AC/leg | Landed | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Multi-family proposer set | `PROPOSER_FAMILIES = {ahe, rho, gene_bank, code_search}` (closed); `RESEARCH_FAMILIES = {rho, gene_bank, code_search}`; research families mandate `maturity_flags ∋ "research-grade"` at `validate` | `crates/hh-evolution/src/records.rs` |
| `code_payload` target class | `EVOLVABLE_TARGET_CLASSES` gains `code_payload` — `CompiledPayload` bodies only, typed + declared-interface-bearing + out-of-process | `crates/hh-evolution/src/records.rs` |
| `SlotAllocation::{voi, concentrate}` | `floors{slot → min_share_ppm}` — sum ≤ 1_000_000 (`BudgetSplittingTrap`), every floor names a declared slot (target class / admitted hosted coordinate / `native`); `voi` requires the corpus's `slot_history` layer (`SchemaViolation` otherwise — ADR-0190's seam) | `crates/hh-evolution/src/records.rs` |
| `ParentSelectionPolicy::{gene_bank, rho}` | `gene_bank{niche}` — niche elite with lineage-wide-elite fallback; `rho{trajectory_ref}` — anchored pick, `None` when no member cites the anchor; both ride the one `select_parent_apply` argmax | `crates/hh-evolution/src/proposer.rs` · `records.rs` (`LineageEntry{niche, trajectory_refs}`) |

## Decisions

See **ADR-0323** — closed family set + mandatory `research-grade` (D1);
`target_classes[]` multi-set with `ahe` still one-class (D2);
`CompiledPayload` stays typed by construction (D3); `rebase` replays the
same edit (D4); hosted admission is records-in, checked at open *and* S1
(D5); `authority_cap` is the install ceiling (D6); `voi` reads the
slot-history layer only (D7); the selectors share one argmax (D8); RHO
declares its corpus dependency (D9); one embed op for `rebase` (D10).

## In-run fixes worth recording

- **`records.rs`/`campaign.rs` edit persistence** — a mid-run tool
  anomaly silently dropped two earlier edits (the
  `HostedCoordinateUnsupported` variant and the `hosted_descriptors`
  helper); caught by `cargo check` (`E0599`/`E0425`) and re-applied.
  Same stale-view signature as the recorded LEDGER anomaly — build-
  memory files continue to go through shell writes + `git diff`
  verification.
- **Intake-row members need ledger declarations** — the `proposed`
  intake row's new `coordinates`/`install` members are audit-grade;
  `check_audit_partition` refuses undeclared members, so
  `TRANSITION_FIELDS` grew (append-only).
- **Open-time descriptor admission** — the spec originally checked
  descriptor refs only at `propose`; `open` now resolves and admits
  (`capability = supported`) so an unsupported hosted coordinate
  refuses the campaign open, not the first assignment.
- **`code_search` hypothesis kind** — the emitted `FailureHypothesis`
  moved `insufficiency` → `observational` to satisfy the suite's
  S2-validity surface (`observational`/`designed_ablation`/`causal_*`).
